subject: Partitioned routing & evidence: Helix Health localization request
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Allen <legalops@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partitioned routing & evidence: Helix Health localization request

Hi Sophie / Raj —

Thanks for the earlier conversation. Following up with a concrete ask so Procurement / Legal can evaluate the mix of safeguards we propose. Helix asked for the ability to keep EU-origin requests processed within EU jurisdictions where possible, with UK routing handled under the UK addendum / IDTA where applicable. To scope that work we need a short matrix from you and some clarifications from LegalOps:

- Confirm which Helix product lines will require EU-only routing vs UK-local processing (list of service codes or endpoints is fine).
- For any data that would remain in the UK, confirm whether the data category is considered special category / NHS regulated (this affects TIA scope).
- Provide procurement contacts and any existing DPA addenda you expect us to accept (UK addendum, national annex, other).

What Redwood can provide now (for your review):
- A routing matrix template (attached) so you can mark desired localization per endpoint/region.
- An evidence checklist showing standard DPA exhibits, subprocessors list, and per-region logging attestations we can produce.

Attachments: routing_matrix_template.csv, requested_evidence_checklist.pdf

Proposed timeline: if you return the matrix by Tuesday 10/6 we can produce a scoped TIA plan and tentative evidence package within 7 business days. If any endpoints require customer-dedicated capacity or on-prem for compliance, we will flag that in the TIA scoping.

Next steps: can we schedule a 30-minute scoping call Friday 10/2 10:00–10:30am UK time? I’ll include Kim (security) and Marissa (privacy) on the call.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Account Team, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Allen <legalops@helixhealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@helixhealth.com>, Helix Health Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 14:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Partitioned routing & evidence: Helix Health localization request

Thanks Naomi —

Appreciate the template. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Product split: EHX-Clinical and EHX-Labs must remain within EU data centers by default; Patient Insights (analytics) may accept UK processing for non-identifiable records. I will send an endpoint-to-product mapping in a separate email.
- NHS/regulatory: EHX-Clinical touches NHS PII in a minority of integrations — this will likely push it into a higher TIA tier.
- Addenda: We expect to review your standard DPA + UK addendum. For procurement we also need a short statement on subcontractor access controls and whether Redwood can provide per-region subprocessor attestations.

Can Kimberly join the scoping call? We want to cover logging, delete/egress procedures, and whether Redwood can segment logs by region for audit.

I’ve tentatively accepted the Friday 10/2 10:00–10:30am UK time slot — will confirm from calendar.

Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partitioned routing & evidence: Helix Health localization request

Hi all —

Quick technical notes ahead of the scoping call:

- Routing options: we can support per-endpoint routing via policy tags at the edge. For EU-only endpoints we will route to EU clusters and enforce KV-cache residency.
- UK addendum vs SCCs: operationally we treat the UK IDTA/UK addendum as equivalent to SCCs for fallback; difference is in legal signoff and evidence type.
- Logging: we can produce region-bound request logs and a redacted token-level cost/latency trace. Full PII-containing payloads are never stored beyond ephemeral runtime unless you request retention for debugging -- we will need a documented retention policy.
- Subprocessors: most of our infra subprocessors are global cloud providers. We can provide per-region access attestations (signed statement from our ops) but cannot produce per-subprocessor per-request traces without a dedicated audit contract.

I attached a short tech note with implementation constraints and estimated lift for per-endpoint dedicated capacity (approx. 2–4 weeks for baseline reconfiguration + testing).

Attachments: technical_routing_notes.md

Happy to walk through these on the call.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security & Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
